description: Validate a Bitcoin output descriptor (wpkh, wsh, tr, pkh, sh, multi, sortedmulti, raw, addr, combo): verifies or computes the 8-character BIP380 checksum, checks derivation paths and xpubs, and derives sample addresses and scriptPubKeys. Never send xprv, WIF, or seed phrases.

creditToken.description: Optional WorkSats bearer credit token (`crd_...`) to pay 2 credits when free daily calls are used up.

deriveCount.description: Number of wildcard addresses to derive from index 0 (0..5, default: 3).

descriptor.description: Public output descriptor string (with or without `#checksum`).

x402TxHash.description: Optional confirmed Base mainnet USDC transfer transaction hash (`0x...`) to pay via x402.

name: check_descriptor
